purpose: Teach: コミットメント/印刷物/公職/増産/ふさわしく/簡略/お買い得/取り直し

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新規プロジェクトへの、本気で、絶対、コミットメント、絶対、社員に、絶対、宣言、絶対、しましょう
lines.en: Let's make a serious, genuine commitment to this new project and announce it to the entire team.
lines.style: Decisive and purposeful. Crisp attack on the opening. Clear conviction — not rushed, but with forward momentum. This is a declaration, not a suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会社の、本気で、絶対、印刷物、絶対、デザイン、絶対、刷新、絶対、検討中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're currently reviewing a complete redesign of our company's printed materials.
lines.style: Earnest and engaged. Steady pace with quiet pride in the progress. Respectful acknowledgment of the initiative. Warmth underneath the professionalism.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 元、本気で、絶対、公職、絶対、にいらした方を、絶対、顧問に、絶対、迎えませんか
lines.en: Wouldn't it be good to bring on someone who used to work in the public sector as an advisor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly hesitant. Testing the idea aloud. Conversational but measured — genuinely curious about his reaction. A question that's actually looking for input.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の、本気で、絶対、増産、絶対、計画、絶対、立てております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively developing a production increase plan for the new product line.
lines.style: Solid and reassuring. Even tone, professional but not stiff. Confidence that comes from having concrete steps underway. Genuine appreciation in the delivery.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界に、本気で、絶対、ふさわしく、絶対、当社、絶対、行動、絶対、しましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure our company acts in a way that's truly fitting for this industry.
lines.style: Measured and principled. Calm but with quiet authority. Not demanding — inviting alignment. The tone of someone who believes in what they're saying.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業務フロー、本気で、絶対、簡略、絶対、化、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're making progress on reshooting the advertisement and handling the necessary revisions.
lines.style: Responsive and diligent. Steady delivery that shows action without fanfare. Matter-of-fact about the work, but with underlying care for getting it right.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 仕入れ先で、本気で、絶対、お買い得、絶対、品、絶対、探しましょう
lines.en: Let's search out good-value items from our suppliers and make smart purchasing decisions.
lines.style: Pragmatic and encouraging. Efficient cadence. Direct but not harsh — this is about intelligence and resourcefulness, not cutting corners.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告撮影の、本気で、絶対、取り直し、絶対、対応、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're already moving forward on reshooting and revising the advertising campaign.
lines.style: Attentive and thorough. Calm delivery that conveys competence. The tone of someone staying on top of details without getting flustered. Closing with earned credibility.
